description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Spark Double and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Spark Double dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Spark Double tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
